title: HackerEarth: Toggle String
description: You have been given a String `s` consisting of uppercase and lowercase English alphabets. You need to change the case of each alphabet in this String (lowercase to uppercase and vice versa).
solution:
def toggle_case(s: str) -> str:
    return s.swapcase()
explanation: Toggles uppercase to lowercase and vice-versa in O(N) time.
